strongest_counterhypothesis: SWC is mostly a semantic relabeling of ordinary CSP/database join-tree decomposition. A conventional exact validator, possibly AC-3 plus SAT/CSP/SMT or query-planner decomposition, provides the same correctness at lower total complexity; therefore no new runtime organ or ClayCode primitive is justified.
evidence_for_counterhypothesis: Prior art covers local/global consistency, acyclic-hypergraph guarantees, decomposition and sheaf/global-section formulations.
The reference implementation obtains its benefit from standard arc consistency, forest detection and backtracking, not from a novel solver primitive.
No real Frank trace demonstrates that a new service/module boundary adds value.
evidence_against_full_counterhypothesis: The synthetic discriminator shows a meaningful separation between unsafe pairwise admission and exact topology-adaptive validation.
The explicit Clay integration can encode Hyperposition preservation, provenance binding and re-entry gating that a generic solver result alone does not specify.
The topology planner can potentially avoid global solving on many episodes while retaining exactness, which is a testable project-specific benefit.
surviving_claim: Research and benchmark a topology-aware workspace coherence compiler/test obligation using conventional exact algorithms behind typed Clay semantics.
rejected_claim: Promote a distinct sheaf/SWC runtime organ or claim a novel mathematical algorithm from current evidence.
next_falsifier: Extract real frozen Frank receiver-scope traces and compare pairwise-only, always-global exact, and topology-adaptive exact validation under matched correctness, latency, CPU/RAM, state amplification, replay and recovery controls.
